name: techstack-gitignore
description: Search, download, and combine .gitignore rules from templates directly from within the editor.
author: Tanmay Pachpande <ptanmay143@outlook.com>

gitignore.cacheExpirationInterval.description: Number of seconds the template list retrieved from GitHub is cached in memory. Set to 0 to disable caching.

gitignore.defaultTemplates.description: Template names that are automatically pre-selected when the .gitignore template picker opens. Names are matched case-insensitively against the GitHub template list.

gitignore.downloadConcurrency.description: Maximum number of .gitignore templates to download in parallel when writing the file.

gitignore.backupSuffix.description: Suffix appended to the backup filename when using 'Backup & replace'. For example, '.backup' produces '.gitignore.backup'.

gitignore.githubApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the GitHub REST API. Change this to use a GitHub Enterprise instance (e.g. https://github.example.com/api/v3).

gitignore.githubRepository.description: GitHub repository (owner/repo) from which .gitignore templates are fetched. Change this to use a custom fork (e.g. myorg/gitignore-templates).

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
